calculation.description: For each tradable asset, compare the standard deviation of negative daily returns with the standard deviation of positive daily returns over the prior 60 completed sessions. Higher values indicate relatively larger downside shocks and are expected to rank lower; the signal is interpretable as a downside-volatility risk measure.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across full history and separately online/recent regimes. Full-history 20-day result passes the benchmark-wide absolute IC and ICIR gates; online and recent results are also positive. Interpret uncertainty conservatively because the cross-section has 15 instruments.

signal_provenance.cutoff_rule: Only observations through the prior completed date are used; no forward data enters the factor.
signal_provenance.signal_artifact: Reproducible from the cited script and source files; no separate cached artifact was required.
